$comment: The reference consumer's half of the cross-repository contract, data only.
The laws are not here. They are the failure messages of the gates in @nanisoft/prism-ui/gates
which this repository pins exactly. What is here is what only this site knows:
which sheet is its own, how much of it counts as having read something, where
its export lands, what its pack map describes, and which source roots read no tokens at runtime.
This site has no own sheet, so the stylesheet-ownership and hidden-state floors are 0.
